Confederation of European Paper Industries (CEPI) (2013). The Two Team Project. Unfold the Future - breakthrough technologies for the pulp and paper industry. CEPI aisbl, Brussels, November 2013. No report number or DOI.

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A 40-page brochure presenting eight pre-competitive breakthrough concepts from CEPI's 2012-13 Two Team Project (DES pulping - the winner; flash condensing with steam; superheated-steam papermaking; DryPulp cure-forming; supercritical-CO2 drying; 100% electricity; functional surface; toolbox). Each concept gets only sector-wide 2050 savings vs the 2011 baseline, estimated on a common sector energy profile, and no per-tonne energy, cost or emissions: DES pulping -20% fossil CO2 and 40% primary energy, investment less than half a chemical pulp mill, units as small as 50 kt/yr, industrial scale within max 15 years (p.16-17); flash condensing with steam -50% fossil CO2, 20% primary energy, drying energy cut by at least 50%, >=10 years to commercial (p.19); superheated-steam concept ~25% energy, -50% fossil CO2, >=30% mill cost reduction, SHS drying by 2020 (p.20-21); DryPulp ~25% energy and -55% CO2, capital up to 20x lower (p.23); scCO2 drying -45% fossil CO2, ~20% primary energy, 10-20% lower energy cost, ~15 years (p.25); 100% electricity: electric boilers almost 100% efficient vs 70-90% for coal/gas boilers, -20% CO2 with current power, energy cost -8% (p.26-27); functional surface -30% material per m2 (p.28); toolbox -40% CO2 and 50% primary energy (p.30). Pages are printed page numbers. The DES numbers are carried more fully by provides_2018_001 (ISPT PROVIDES booklet). Kept as background for digester_deep-eutectic-solvent and paper-machine_waterless.
